HELP & POLICIES

How can we help?

Everything about delivery, exchange and your data, in one place.

ShippingReturnsFAQContactPrivacyTerms

Shipping & delivery

We deliver across Bangladesh.

  • Inside Rajshahi: 1–2 days. Outside Rajshahi: 3–5 days.
  • Delivery charge is ৳60 inside Rajshahi and ৳120 outside Rajshahi. Delivery is free on orders of ৳1,500 or more.
  • After you order, we confirm the details with you by phone or WhatsApp before we dispatch.
  • Cash on delivery is available. Please keep the exact amount ready for the delivery person.

Returns & exchange

Wrong size? You can swap it within 7 days of delivery.

  • The piece must be unworn and unwashed, with its tags attached.
  • Message us on WhatsApp with your order number and the size you want. Exchanges depend on stock.
  • If your order arrives damaged, or you received the wrong item, contact us as soon as you can with a photo and we will make it right.

Frequently asked

Do I need an account to order?

No. You can check out as a guest. Just add your pieces to the cart and fill in your delivery details.

How do I pay?

Cash on delivery, bKash or Nagad. For bKash and Nagad, send the amount to the number shown at checkout and enter the Transaction ID so we can match your payment.

How long does delivery take?

1–2 days inside Rajshahi and 3–5 days elsewhere in Bangladesh.

How much is delivery?

৳60 inside Rajshahi and ৳120 outside Rajshahi. It is free when your order is ৳1,500 or more.

How do I choose my size?

Open any piece and use the size guide. Between sizes? Go one up for a relaxed fit. Oversized pieces are cut boxy, so take your usual size.

How do I know my order is confirmed?

After you place an order, tap the WhatsApp button on the confirmation page to send us your order details. We will then confirm by phone or WhatsApp.

Can I change or cancel my order?

Message us on WhatsApp as soon as possible with your order number, before it is dispatched.

Privacy policy

What we collect. Your name, phone number, delivery address, order details and, if you give it, your email. We only ask for what we need to deliver your order.

How we use it. To process and deliver your order, to contact you about it, and to send our newsletter only if you subscribe.

Where it is kept. Your cart, saved pieces and saved details are stored in your own browser on your device. Your order reaches us when you send it to us on WhatsApp.

Sharing. We share your name, phone and address with our delivery partners only so they can deliver your order. We never sell your data.

Your choices. You can clear your saved details at any time from your account page, or ask us to delete anything we hold about you.

Terms of service

Prices. All prices are in Bangladeshi Taka (৳). We may change prices or correct errors at any time.

Orders. Placing an order is a request to buy. An order is confirmed once we contact you. We may cancel an order if an item is out of stock or we cannot reach you.

Payment. You can pay by cash on delivery, bKash or Nagad. For mobile payments, the Transaction ID you enter must match a real payment to us.

Delivery and exchange. See our shipping and returns sections above.
